## Goal

Motion graphics and decks authored as ordinary React and MDX, deterministic for screenshots and reviewable in time.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| KT-06 | Mostra's own frame-based motion composition primitive with play, scrub and loop; deterministic for screenshots | M, B, R | Timeline frames render deterministically (pixel-identical screenshots at given frames); play, scrub, loop; Mirza reviews |
| KT-07 | Mostra's own MDX deck runtime with layouts, click steps, presenter view and print to PDF | B, R | Deck fixture: layouts, clicks, presenter view sync, print to PDF one slide per page; Mirza reviews |
| RV-06 | Comments on timelines, motion and video anchor to time plus region, and on slides to slide and step | B | Comments on a Timeline, a video and a deck slide anchor to time plus region or slide plus step and re-resolve after reload |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

`@mostra/kit/motion` (`Timeline`, `Clip`, `useFrame`, `interpolate`, `spring`; play, scrub, loop, poster; reduced motion; time-and-region review anchors); `@mostra/kit/deck` (Slidev-style MDX grammar, layouts, clicks, notes, presenter view, print to PDF; Shiki, KaTeX and Mermaid blocks); the Remotion and GSAP adapters, user-installed with the license flow, as first-party plugins proven through `mostra plugin verify` (moved from WP-25, D184); the deck template and its gallery entry (moved from WP-26, D184).

Design detail for this package:

- `Timeline`, `Clip`, `useFrame`, `interpolate`, `spring`, controls, reduced motion; names distinct from Remotion's.
- Deck grammar, layouts, clicks, notes, presenter view, print to PDF.
- Time-and-region and slide-and-step review anchors (RV-06).
- From D184: the Remotion and GSAP adapters (user-installed, `--accept-license`) declare their engines in `bundledLicenses` as `LicenseRef-Remotion` and `LicenseRef-GSAP-Standard-No-Charge` with class, summary and link, on WP-25's `mostra plugin verify`; and the deck template and its gallery entry join WP-26's templates and gallery.

## Acceptance evidence

deterministic frame screenshots; a deck fixture in three browsers; a printed PDF has one slide per page; presenter view syncs; Mirza reviews a representative deck; each adapter passes its baselines through `mostra plugin verify`, and the license acknowledgment of its engine is recorded in the lockfile.

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Determinism: frame rendering must not depend on wall-clock time.
